Australian Shares Fall to Three-Month Low Amid Global Market Concerns

The Australian share market (ASX) reached a two-month low, with one report indicating it could recover slightly. Wall Street extended its sell-off, influenced by surging oil prices due to potential disruptions in Saudi Arabian crude supplies. Separately, former Australian Prime Minister Kevin Rudd described the risks associated with Artificial Intelligence as 'deadly serious'. The coverage also noted that Donald Trump's 'worst market nightmare' had become a possibility.
